definitions.gloss: to resist; to oppose; to put up resistance
definitions.explanation: To actively fight against or refuse to accept a force, authority, or situation. Can be physical resistance or abstract opposition.

definitions.gloss: to feel reluctant; to have reservations about
definitions.explanation: To feel a psychological aversion or discomfort toward something. Used when something goes against one's feelings or values.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- [force/authority]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抵抗|ていこう}する (to resist [something] — sense 1)
- [thing]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to feel reluctance about [something] — sense 2)

NOUN USAGE:
⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ is frequently used as a standalone noun: ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have reluctance), ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel resistance).
